import React, { useMemo, useState } from "react"; import "./ProjectJourney.css"; const projects = [ { id: 1, title: "The Grand Residency", location: "Greater Noida", type: "Residential", configuration: "2, 3 & 4 BHK", price: "₹68 Lakh - ₹1.35 Cr", status: "New Launch", image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1600607687920-4e2a09cf159d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=85", }, { id: 2, title: "Royal Palm Heights", location: "Noida Extension", type: "Residential", configuration: "2 & 3 BHK", price: "₹52 Lakh - ₹89 Lakh", status: "Verified", image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1600585154340-be6161a56a0c?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=85", }, { id: 3, title: "Urban Crest", location: "Noida Sector 150", type: "Residential", configuration: "3 & 4 BHK", price: "₹1.10 Cr - ₹2.25 Cr", status: "Featured", image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1600566753086-00f18fb6b3ea?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=85", }, { id: 4, title: "The Business Avenue", location: "Greater Noida West", type: "Commercial", configuration: "Retail & Office", price: "₹45 Lakh onwards", status: "Commercial", image: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1497366811353-6870744d04b2?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1200&q=85", }, ]; const assistance = [ { icon: "⌂", title: "Home Search", text: "Discover properties that match your budget, location and lifestyle.", }, { icon: "✓", title: "Builder Check", text: "Get guidance on project information, builder details and documentation.", }, { icon: "▣", title: "Legal Help", text: "Understand important property documents and transaction requirements.", }, { icon: "↗", title: "Negotiation Support", text: "Get professional assistance while discussing property pricing and terms.", }, ]; const reasons = [ { icon: "✓", title: "Verified & Trusted Projects", text: "Explore carefully selected projects with important property information presented clearly.", }, { icon: "◆", title: "Direct Deal Assistance", text: "We help you understand builder offerings, pricing and available options.", }, { icon: "♡", title: "Personalized Guidance", text: "Your property search is supported according to your requirements and budget.", }, { icon: "✦", title: "Dedicated Customer Support", text: "From your first enquiry to property selection, our team stays available to assist.", }, ]; function ProjectJourney() { const [city, setCity] = useState(""); const [status, setStatus] = useState(""); const [search, setSearch] = useState(""); const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: "", phone: "", email: "", requirement: "", message: "", }); const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false); const filteredProjects = useMemo(() => { return projects.filter((project) => { const cityMatch = !city || project.location.toLowerCase().includes(city.toLowerCase()); const statusMatch = !status || project.status.toLowerCase().includes(status.toLowerCase()) || project.type.toLowerCase().includes(status.toLowerCase()); const searchMatch = !search || project.title.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || project.location.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) || project.type.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()); return cityMatch && statusMatch && searchMatch; }); }, [city, status, search]); const handleFormChange = (e) => { setForm({ ...form, [e.target.name]: e.target.value, }); }; const handleSubmit = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (!form.name || !form.phone) { alert("Please enter your name and phone number."); return; } const oldData = JSON.parse( localStorage.getItem("rehouse_project_enquiries") || "[]" ); const enquiry = { ...form, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), source: "REHOUSE REALTORS Project Page", }; localStorage.setItem( "rehouse_project_enquiries", JSON.stringify([...oldData, enquiry]) ); window.dispatchEvent( new CustomEvent("rehouse-project-enquiry", { detail: form, }) ); setSubmitted(true); setForm({ name: "", phone: "", email: "", requirement: "", message: "", }); }; const scrollToExpert = () => { document .getElementById("rehouse-expert") ?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" }); }; return (
